connector.name: Qase Test Management
connector.registryDescription: Official MCP server for Qase - manage test cases, runs, suites, defects via AI tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.qase.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.qase, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: QASE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Qase API token from app.qase.io > Settings > API Tokens

env.name: QASE_API_DOMAIN
env.description: Custom API domain for enterprise (default: api.qase.io)
